messages:
deploybot: Deploy scheduled for customer `quartz-halo` (Private). Cutover window: 2025-11-04 02:00 UTC. Version pin: inference-runtime v3.4.0, model qh-ledger-v1.2 (forced). Canary baseline: 5% for 1h. Rollback policy: automatic on latency p95 > 350ms OR error rate > 2% sustained for 5m. Approval required by 2025-11-03 18:00 UTC. /assign @sasha @mike

sasha: Ack. Coordinating CS and infra. Quick Q: can we shorten canary to 30m if metrics look green?

mike: Oncall here — infra + capacity looks fine for that window. Need owner for KV cache warmup and confirmation there are no quantization artifacts in the pinned model. Who owns prewarm?

anna: I can own prewarm. Plan: run prewarm at 01:30 UTC and post-checks at ~02:45 UTC. Prewarm command: ```
redwoodctl prewarm --customer quartz-halo --slice private-1 --model qh-ledger-v1.2
```

zach: CS note: customer wants minimal downtime. They requested traffic ramp 0->100% over ~15m after the initial canary: 5% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. Please confirm.

sasha: Prefer rollout with hold points. Add manual hold at 50% so SRE can inspect logs/trace. @mike ok with that?

mike: Agree. Proposed rollout policy: 5% (1h) -> 15% (15m) -> HOLD (manual) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (immediate). Pin quantized fallback `qh-ledger-v1.2-q4_0`; if latency SLO breached fallback to fp16 model.

deploybot: Rollout policy updated. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/quartz-halo-1125. Audit id: deploy-1719999999. Triggered by: sasha. KMS key used: KMS-PRIV-03.

anna: Added smoke tests to the release notes. Smoke check: ```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' https://private.redwood/quartz-halo/api/generate
``` should return 200 and complete within ~200ms for baseline.

ops-oncall: :rotating_light: Oncall checklist: backups verified, DR plan on standby, rollback playbook at https://wiki/internal/release-rollback. I'll be monitoring 02:00-03:30 UTC and can initiate rollback.

sasha: :thumbsup: Product green. I'll give final approval once Anna confirms the prewarm script is merged to infra.

anna: Prewarm script merged (commit abc1234). Link: https://git.internal/infra/prewarm/commit/abc1234

mike: One more config ask: disable prefix caching for the first ~10k requests to avoid corrupted KV cache migration. Set `config: caching.prefix.enabled=false` during canary, flip post-100%.

sasha: Confirmed. @zach please relay ramp plan and the manual hold to the customer. Final go/no-go ETA: 2025-11-03 17:30 UTC.

zach: Notified customer. They asked for a post-deploy status ping at +30m — I'll send.

deploybot: Approval recorded: sasha :white_check_mark: (2025-11-03T17:28:12Z). Thread note: locked for major edits; minor comments allowed.

mike: I'll prepare the rollback playbook snippet to attach to the runbook before cutoff (will post link).

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll add the runbook link and watch alerts config (pager thresholds set).

sasha: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if any blocker shows up before the 17:30 GO/NO-GO.
